assets.intent: Repair the original sign with genuine transparent boundaries
assets.prompt: Edit target: the supplied My Panaderya bakery sign raster asset. Reconstruct this ONE standalone game logo faithfully, preserving the exact words 'My Panaderya', playful plump cream lettering with dark cocoa outlines and warm caramel extruded shadows, pink oval enamel plaque, wooden outline, chef hat centered on top, symmetrical golden wheat on both ends and a golden bread loaf below the letters. Repair the actual asset: remove all baked peach room/background rectangles, bottom horizontal shelf lines, cut-off lower border, strange edge fragments and malformed details. Complete the entire wooden sign perimeter on all sides with clean coherent outlines; no clipping. Make left/right ornamental flourishes balanced without changing the established art direction. Transparent background only outside the complete sign silhouette; genuine clean alpha, no rectangular background, no ground plane or external shadow or extra objects. Wide horizontal asset with a little transparent margin around the full perimeter. This is a production logo repair, no new decorative elements or scene.
